notes: Wed 14 - Fri 16 entries carry timeZoneID America/New_York (EDT, UTC-4); the device zone is Europe/Rome.
In their own zone: 14 Oct 14:30 EDT = afternoon; 14 Oct 20:30 EDT (15 Oct 00:30Z) = evening; 15 Oct 09:00 EDT (13:00Z) = morning. In Rome time they would be evening, night and afternoon.
Same shape as afternoon-dip in local time: 7 Low afternoons, 4 Good mornings, 3 Good evenings -> same numbers.
Every local date has 1 Low + 1 Good -> no weekday candidate (dates in each entry's own zone).
Two clusters (Milan 8 entries, New York 6), both mean 2.0 -> no place candidate.
